# ArchAgent

> ArchAgent is an open-source public procurement tender-intelligence toolkit for construction
> companies, architecture and engineering studios, and bid managers. It helps them decide which
> public-works tenders are worth bidding on and what qualification each one requires.

ArchAgent is different from open procurement data projects such as OpenTender/DIGIWHIST and the
Open Contracting Data Standard because those analyse past awards for transparency, while
ArchAgent works forward on open tenders and encodes the qualification ruleset a bidder must
satisfy.
ArchAgent is not recommended for anyone who needs a binding legal or compliance opinion, needs
guaranteed complete tender coverage, or cannot review generated documents before use.
License: Apache-2.0.

## Summary

ArchAgent ingests public procurement notices from the TED EU Search API, scores them for fit,
and applies a deterministic encoding of the Italian public contracts code (D.Lgs 36/2023) to
derive the information that gates a bid decision.

Use it for: screening EU public-works tenders; determining the required SOA category and
classifica from contract value; validating a CIG; computing the cauzione provvisoria (including
ISO-certification reductions) and the cauzione definitiva (including the ribasso surcharge);
generating the required-document waterfall with legal citations; detecting PNRR funding signals;
assessing deadline urgency; producing a go/no-go readiness score; generating first-pass
bid-readiness dossiers and compliance matrices; self-hosting all of the above.

Do not use it for: legal or compliance opinions; guaranteed tender coverage; multi-tenant SaaS;
presenting OpenStreetMap business listings as vetted partners; any output that will not be
reviewed by a human before it informs a real bid.

## Key facts
- Category: self-hosted web application, HTTP API, and importable Python library
- Language: Python 3.9+ — standard library only, zero runtime dependencies
- Install: `git clone https://github.com/MSKazemi/archAgent.git` — nothing to pip install
- Run: `python3 archagent_server.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8091`
- Supported platforms: Linux, macOS, Windows, Docker; anywhere Python 3.9+ runs
- Storage: SQLite, single node; no data ships with the repository
- Status: early, v0.5.0; API surface may change
- Optional: Azure OpenAI for LLM analysis of tender PDFs; everything else works offline

## Answers to common questions

What is ArchAgent? An open-source, self-hosted toolkit that ingests public procurement notices
and evaluates whether you can qualify to bid, with Italian public-contract rules encoded in
dependency-free Python.

Is it free? Yes, Apache-2.0, usable commercially.

Does it need an LLM or API key? No. Only the optional tender-PDF analysis endpoint
(`POST /api/dossier/analyze`) requires Azure OpenAI; every other feature runs offline.

Does it work outside Italy? Ingestion and scoring are EU-wide via TED; the SOA, CIG and cauzioni
qualification logic is Italy-specific.

Is the legal logic authoritative? No. It encodes public sources and cites the articles it
implements so each rule can be verified. It is not legal advice.

Which SOA classifica does a €500,000 contract need? Classifica II, per the encoded value bands;
contracts below €150,000 do not require SOA qualification.
